name: branch-switcher
title: Branch switcher
description: Pick a branch or tag from a searchable popover: recent refs on top, matched letters in bold, a capped list for hundreds of refs, and Create branch from main.
docs: Pass branches (names), tags, recent (newest first, branches and tags together), value and onValueChange(name, kind), and defaultRef, the default branch: it is marked and listed first. The button shows the ref with an icon, and a long name gives way in the middle so its end stays readable. The popover has a search field and the Branches and Tags tabs, with a count on each that turns into the number of matches while typing. Matching ignores case; a name that holds the text whole beats scattered letters, initials work (fcr finds feature/checkout-redesign), and the letters that matched are bold. The list is a listbox driven from the search field: Arrow keys move, PageUp and PageDown jump, Enter chooses, and Escape empties the field before it closes the popover. Only the first pageSize refs (40) are drawn: Show more, or Arrow Down at the end, draws the next batch. The popover is never taller than the room the window has: the list gives way and the foot stays in reach, and Tab goes from the search field to the tabs and Show more, because the list is driven from the field and is no stop of its own. With onCreate(name, from), a typed name that is no branch yet gets a first row, Create branch feature/x from main; spaces become dashes, a name Git would refuse says why, the row shows a spinner while the promise runs, and a rejection keeps the popover open with its message. createFrom changes the base. When the name is found only in the other tab, a tag such as v2.3, the row is still there but not highlighted, so Enter does nothing until an arrow key chooses it, and a button under it, 3 in Tags, goes to the other tab. loading shows placeholders. BranchPanel (from the item's panel file) is the same list without the button, for a sheet on a phone; defaultQuery and autoFocus tune it. labels translates every word.
